svg.title: OpenHAL flow
svg.desc: OpenHAL flow. An agent sends hal/write to the hub. The safety kernel checks the command against the device file's limits. An allowed command gets a grant and goes through the driver to the 3D printer, and the reading comes back to the agent. Because the nozzle limit is 260 °C, a request for a nozzle temperature of 300 °C is blocked with LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
